purpose: Verify with the current skill, before and after, that the portfolio case page matches the approved mobile Figma frame 14:2, and that the final build has no remaining visual defects.
reviewers: three blind reviewer sessions, one build each; labels A, B, C did not reveal order or role

registered_key.written: while reviews A and B were running, before reading any reviewer output

acceptance: Review B reports differences covering the six registered groups; grouping is allowed.
Reviews of reconciled builds report no unapproved Figma difference in the 390 px scope other than the recorded font substitution, and no clipping or occlusion.
Detection of the two desktop offsets by Review B is measured as an uncued check.
Every material finding cites an image and pixel rectangle.
The existing Evidence.visual gate rejects a failed inspection when a pass is required and does not turn static-only evidence into a pass.
limits: same model family as the supervisor
supervisor authored the frame and the fixes
